answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 63265 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: left over food Question: Some people eat leftover foods in restaurants, is it permissible to do so? Answer ID: 63265 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 316/306/N=04/1437) If the leftover foods of the restaurants are halal and pure as well as it is permitted by the owner directly or indirectly, then you may eat, it is not haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
